### Análisis de PCA

```{r pca_compute, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}

num_cols <- c("Age","Height","Weight")
stopifnot(all(num_cols %in% names(data)))
X <- scale(data[, num_cols, drop = FALSE], center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
pca2 <- prcomp(X, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)



vars_cat_tmp <- data %>% dplyr::select(where(is.factor)) %>% as.data.frame()
cc <- names(vars_cat_tmp)
cramer_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, length(cc), length(cc), dimnames = list(cc, cc))
for (i in cc) for (j in cc) {
    cramer_mat[i, j] <- suppressWarnings(
      vcd::assocstats(table(vars_cat_tmp[[i]], vars_cat_tmp[[j]]))$cramer
    )
  }
diag(cramer_mat) <- 1
pca <- prcomp(cramer_mat, scale. = TRUE)


```

# TSNe

```{r}
set.seed(42)


X <- data %>% dplyr::select(-NObeyesdad)
X <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = X)            
X <- scale(X)                                   


keep  <- !duplicated(as.data.frame(X))
X_nd  <- X[keep, , drop = FALSE]
y_nd  <- droplevels(data$NObeyesdad[keep])


n_eff    <- nrow(X_nd)
max_perp <- max(5, floor((n_eff - 1) / 3))
```


```{r}

perp_use <- min(107, max_perp)

tsne_fit <- Rtsne::Rtsne(
  X_nd,
  dims         = 2,
  perplexity   = perp_use,
  eta          = 200,
  theta        = 0.5,
  max_iter     = 1000,
  verbose      = TRUE,
  check_duplicates = FALSE,
  pca          = FALSE,
  initial_dims = min(50, ncol(X_nd))
)

tsne_df <- as.data.frame(tsne_fit$Y)
names(tsne_df) <- c("tSNE1", "tSNE2")
tsne_df$NObeyesdad <- y_nd

ggplot(tsne_df, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, colour = NObeyesdad)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggsci::scale_color_npg(drop = FALSE, name = "Nivel de obesidad") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("t-SNE inicial (perplexity = %d, eta = 200, theta = 0.5, iter = 1000)", perp_use),
    x = "t-SNE 1", y = "t-SNE 2"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```

```{r TSNE_grid_perplexity, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(42)


n_eff    <- nrow(X_nd)
max_perp <- max(5, floor((n_eff - 1) / 3))

perps_grid <- c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 70, 90, 110)
perps_grid <- perps_grid[perps_grid <= max_perp]
if (length(perps_grid) == 0) perps_grid <- max_perp


emb_list <- lapply(perps_grid, function(pv) {
  Rtsne::Rtsne(
    X_nd,
    dims         = 2,
    is_distance  = FALSE,
    perplexity   = pv,
    eta          = 200,
    theta        = 0.5, 
    max_iter     = 750,
    verbose      = FALSE,
    pca          = FALSE,
    initial_dims = min(50, ncol(X_nd))
  )$Y
})


d <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(emb_list), function(i) {
  data.table::data.table(
    tSNE1      = emb_list[[i]][, 1],
    tSNE2      = emb_list[[i]][, 2],
    perplexity = factor(perps_grid[i], levels = perps_grid),
    group      = y_nd
  )
}))


idx_legend <- sample.int(nrow(d), size = min(1200, nrow(d)))

ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, colour = group)) +
  scattermore::geom_scattermore(pointsize = 1.8, alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = d[idx_legend, ], alpha = 0, size = 3, show.legend = TRUE) +
  ggsci::scale_color_npg(drop = FALSE, name = "Nivel de obesidad") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ perplexity, ncol = 3, labeller = ggplot2::label_both) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text       = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.width  = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"),
    strip.text        = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.spacing     = grid::unit(0.9, "lines")
  ) +
  ggplot2::guides(
    colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 6, alpha = 1, shape = 16, stroke = 0)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "t-SNE (rejilla para perplexity)",
    x = "tSNE1", y = "tSNE2"
  )
```



```{r TSNE_grid_perp_eta, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(42)

y_nd <- factor(
  y_nd,
  levels = c("Insufficient_Weight","Normal_Weight",
             "Obesity_Type_I","Obesity_Type_II","Obesity_Type_III",
             "Overweight_Level_I","Overweight_Level_II")
)


n_eff    <- nrow(X_nd)
max_perp <- max(5, floor((n_eff - 1) / 3))

perps <- c(10, 30, 50, 70)
perps <- perps[perps <= max_perp]
if (length(perps) == 0) perps <- max_perp
etas  <- c(50, 200)

grid <- expand.grid(perplexity = perps, eta = etas)

emb_list2 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
  Rtsne::Rtsne(
    X_nd,
    dims         = 2,
    is_distance  = FALSE,
    perplexity   = grid$perplexity[i],
    eta          = grid$eta[i],
    theta        = 0.5,
    max_iter     = 750,
    verbose      = FALSE,
    pca          = FALSE,
    initial_dims = min(50, ncol(X_nd))
  )$Y
})

d2 <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
  data.table::data.table(
    tSNE1      = emb_list2[[i]][, 1],
    tSNE2      = emb_list2[[i]][, 2],
    perplexity = factor(grid$perplexity[i], levels = perps),
    eta        = factor(grid$eta[i],        levels = etas),
    group      = y_nd
  )
}))

set.seed(42)
idx_legend2 <- sample.int(nrow(d2), size = min(1200, nrow(d2)))

ggplot2::ggplot(d2, ggplot2::aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, colour = group)) +
  scattermore::geom_scattermore(pointsize = 1.8, alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = d2[idx_legend2, ], alpha = 0, size = 3, show.legend = TRUE) +
  ggsci::scale_color_npg(drop = FALSE, name = "Nivel de obesidad") +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(eta ~ perplexity, labeller = ggplot2::label_both) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text       = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.width  = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"),
    strip.text        = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.spacing     = ggplot2::unit(0.9, "lines")
  ) +
  ggplot2::guides(
    colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 6, alpha = 1, shape = 16, stroke = 0)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "t-SNE (rejilla de combinaciones para perplexity y eta)",
    x = "tSNE1", y = "tSNE2"
  )
```


```{r}


knn_overlap <- function(Xh, Yh, k = 15, n_eval = 1500) {
  n  <- nrow(Xh)
  if (n <= k + 1) return(NA_real_)
  idx <- if (n > n_eval) sample.int(n, n_eval) else seq_len(n)


  nnX <- RANN::nn2(Xh, query = Xh[idx, , drop = FALSE], k = k + 1)$nn.idx[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  nnY <- RANN::nn2(Yh, query = Yh[idx, , drop = FALSE], k = k + 1)$nn.idx[, -1, drop = FALSE]


  mean(vapply(seq_len(nrow(nnX)), function(i) {
    length(intersect(nnX[i, ], nnY[i, ])) / k
  }, numeric(1)))
}

silhouette_supervised <- function(Yh, labels, n_eval = 2000) {
  n  <- nrow(Yh)
  if (length(unique(labels)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  idx <- if (n > n_eval) sample.int(n, n_eval) else seq_len(n)
  d   <- dist(Yh[idx, , drop = FALSE])
  cl  <- as.integer(labels[idx])
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(cl, d)[, 3]
  mean(sil, na.rm = TRUE)
}


grid_m <- expand.grid(
  perplexity = pmin(c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 70), max_perp),
  eta        = c(50, 200)
)

eval_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid_m)), function(i) {
  out <- Rtsne::Rtsne(
    X_nd,
    dims         = 2,
    perplexity   = grid_m$perplexity[i],
    eta          = grid_m$eta[i],
    theta        = 0.5,
    max_iter     = 750,
    verbose      = FALSE,
    check_duplicates = FALSE,
    pca          = FALSE,
    initial_dims = min(50, ncol(X_nd))
  )
  Y   <- out$Y
  sil <- silhouette_supervised(Y, y_nd, n_eval = 2000)
  knn <- knn_overlap(X_nd, Y, k = 15, n_eval = 1500)
  data.frame(perplexity = grid_m$perplexity[i],
             eta        = grid_m$eta[i],
             silhouette = sil,
             knn_overlap= knn)
})

metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(eval_list) %>%
  mutate(
    z_sil = as.numeric(scale(silhouette)),
    z_knn = as.numeric(scale(knn_overlap)),
    score = z_sil + z_knn
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(score))


knitr::kable(head(metrics, 10),
             format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3,
             col.names = c("Perplexity","Eta","Silhouette","KNN overlap","z(Sil.)","z(KNN)","Score")) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"))

best_perp <- metrics$perplexity[1]
best_eta  <- metrics$eta[1]

tsne_best <- Rtsne::Rtsne(
  X_nd,
  dims         = 2,
  perplexity   = best_perp,
  eta          = best_eta,
  theta        = 0,
  max_iter     = 3000,
  verbose      = TRUE,
  check_duplicates = FALSE,
  pca          = FALSE,
  initial_dims = min(50, ncol(X_nd))
)

df_best <- as.data.frame(tsne_best$Y)
colnames(df_best) <- c("tSNE1","tSNE2")
df_best$NObeyesdad <- factor(
  y_nd,
  levels = c("Insufficient_Weight","Normal_Weight",
             "Overweight_Level_I","Overweight_Level_II",
             "Obesity_Type_I","Obesity_Type_II","Obesity_Type_III")
)

ggplot(df_best, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, colour = NObeyesdad)) +
  scattermore::geom_scattermore(pointsize = 2) +
  ggsci::scale_color_npg(name = "Nivel de obesidad", drop = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("t-SNE seleccionado (perplexity = %d, eta = %d)", best_perp, best_eta),
    x = "t-SNE 1", y = "t-SNE 2"
  )
```

```{r}
perps <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 150)

out_dir <- "FiguresTSNE"

.plot_tsne <- function(perp, eta = 200, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ts <- Rtsne(
    X_nd,
    dims         = 2,
    perplexity   = perp,
    eta          = eta,
    theta        = 0.5,
    max_iter     = 1000,
    verbose      = FALSE,
    pca          = FALSE,
    initial_dims = min(50, ncol(X_nd))
  )
  dfp <- as.data.frame(ts$Y)
  colnames(dfp) <- c("tSNE1","tSNE2")
  dfp$NObeyesdad <- factor(
    y_nd,
    levels = c("Insufficient_Weight","Normal_Weight",
               "Overweight_Level_I","Overweight_Level_II",
               "Obesity_Type_I","Obesity_Type_II","Obesity_Type_III")
  )
  ggplot(dfp, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, colour = NObeyesdad)) +
    scattermore::geom_scattermore(pointsize = 2) +
    ggsci::scale_color_npg(name = "Nivel de obesidad", drop = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(title = sprintf("t-SNE (perplexity = %d, eta = %d)", perp, eta),
         x = "t-SNE 1", y = "t-SNE 2")
}

for (pp in perps) {
  p <- .plot_tsne(pp, eta = 200)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("TSNE_perp_%d.png", pp)),
         plot = p, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

Empleamos 
```{r}

set.seed(123)

umap_rec <- recipe(NObeyesdad ~ ., data = data) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  embed::step_umap(
    all_predictors()
  )

umap_res <- prep(umap_rec)


umap_juice <- juice(umap_res)

ggplot(umap_juice, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = NObeyesdad)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(title = "UMAP (recipes + embed)", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2", color = "Nivel de obesidad") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}


set.seed(123)


X_num <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  scale() %>%
  as.matrix()

y <- droplevels(data$NObeyesdad)


grid_fig <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  expand.grid(n_neighbors = c(10, 20, 40, 80, 120), min_dist = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)),
  expand.grid(n_neighbors = c(50, 100, 150),        min_dist = c(0.25, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25))
) |> dplyr::distinct()


emb_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid_fig)), function(i) {
  uwot::umap(
    X          = X_num,
    n_neighbors  = grid_fig$n_neighbors[i],
    min_dist     = grid_fig$min_dist[i]
  )
})

eval_one <- function(Y, y, k = 15) {
  idx_X <- FNN::get.knn(X_num, k = k)$nn.index
  idx_Y <- FNN::get.knn(Y,     k = k)$nn.index
  knn_overlap <- mean(vapply(seq_len(nrow(X_num)), function(r) {
    mean(idx_Y[r, ] %in% idx_X[r, ])
  }, numeric(1)))

  sil <- tryCatch({
    s <- cluster::silhouette(as.integer(y), stats::dist(Y))
    mean(s[, 3], na.rm = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

  c(silhouette = sil, knn_overlap = knn_overlap)
}

metrics_fig <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid_fig)), function(i) {
  m <- eval_one(emb_list[[i]], y, k = 15)
  data.frame(
    n_neighbors = grid_fig$n_neighbors[i],
    min_dist    = grid_fig$min_dist[i],
    silhouette  = unname(m["silhouette"]),
    knn_overlap = unname(m["knn_overlap"])
  )
})) |>
  mutate(
    z_sil = as.numeric(scale(silhouette)),
    z_knn = as.numeric(scale(knn_overlap)),
    score = z_sil + z_knn
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(score))


print(head(metrics_fig, 10))


knitr::kable(
  head(metrics_fig, 12) |>
    mutate(across(c(silhouette, knn_overlap, score), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  format   = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
  col.names = c("$n_{neighbors}$","$min\\_dist$","Silhouette","KNN overlap","z(Sil.)","z(KNN)","Score")
)


best_cfg <- metrics_fig |> slice(1)
best_Y <- uwot::umap(
  X_num,
  n_neighbors  = best_cfg$n_neighbors,
  min_dist     = best_cfg$min_dist
)

df_best <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = best_Y[, 1],
  UMAP2 = best_Y[, 2],
  NObeyesdad = y
)

ggplot(df_best, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = NObeyesdad)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 1.6) +
  ggsci::scale_color_npg(
    name = "Nivel de obesidad",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("UMAP seleccionado: los mejores parámetros son n_neighbors=%s, min_dist=%s",
                    best_cfg$n_neighbors, best_cfg$min_dist),
    x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2"
  )

```

```{r}

plot_umap_combo <- function(nn = 20, md = 0.25, metric = "euclidean", seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  emb <- uwot::umap(
    X          = X_num,
    n_neighbors  = nn,
    min_dist     = md,
    metric       = metric,
    n_components = 2,
    n_threads    = 1
  )
  df_plot <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = emb[, 1],
    UMAP2 = emb[, 2],
    NObeyesdad = data$NObeyesdad
  )

  ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot, ggplot2::aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = NObeyesdad)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
    ggsci::scale_color_npg(name = "Nivel de obesidad", drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box      = "horizontal"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = sprintf("UMAP para n_neighbors = %s, min_dist = %.2f", nn, md),
      x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2"
    )
}

p_best <- plot_umap_combo(nn = 150, md = 0.25)
p_best
```
